pr_body:
ScriptScoreQuery is an elasticsearch query implementation that the plain
highlighter doesn't know anything about.  To highlight it correctly, we need
to add some custom handling logic in our CustomQueryScorer.

Fixes #99700
pr_title: Correctly handle ScriptScoreQuery in plain highlighter
pr_comment: Hi @romseygeek, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

There are almost certainly other places where we are using a `ScriptService` when we could quite happily be using a `ScriptCompiler`, and replacing things there would probably simplify a whole bunch of tests.

review_comment: Note that these changes (replacing a reference to the concrete ScriptService class with one to its ScriptCompiler interface instead) make using scripts in tests a lot easier.
